Class manager_reports

java.lang.Object
controller.manager_reports
public class manager_reports extends Object
Managere Report Page

Handles the GUI and logic implementation of the manager reports page, which allows managers to view sales reports, including best/worst selling items and daily income.

      private String formatSalesItem(Connection connection, LocalDate selectedDate, String itemColumn, boolean bestSelling) throws SQLException
      Queries the database for the top or bottom selling items based on the given parameters.
      Parameters:
      connection - active database connection
      selectedDate - target date for the query
      itemColumn - column name for drink or topping
      bestSelling - true for highest sales, false for lowest sales
      Returns:
      formatted string showing name and count, or a fallback message
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the SQL query fails
